name: @tikoci/tzsp-sniff
description: Receive and decode TZSP packet streams from RouterOS (/tool/sniffer, mangle sniff-tzsp) without root, with output sized for agents

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build && bun run test:node
scripts.lint: bun run lint:types && bun run lint:code && bun run lint:markdown && bun run lint:words && bun run lint:bun-pin && bun run lint:external
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --target node --format esm --outdir dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
